review_role: Independent source-evidence auditor; separate from evidence collection and implementation

scope.selection: Current official SSE daily trading OHLC for only the exact frozen DQ001 source-value tuples; these equal the archived Tencent-side values.

rationale: The exchange official page, namespace and chart code directly establish the source and date/open/high/low/close field mapping. Exact Decimal comparison finds all twenty SSE fields equal to the archived Tencent values and each exactly 0.001 below archived Eastmoney, without tolerance or rescaling. Contemporaneous target-period charts and cash-dividend checkpoints support nominal trading-price basis. Exchange-source precedence, not provider voting or strategy outcomes, is sufficient to settle this bounded price-selection conflict; upstream cause is a separate unknown.

price_basis_review.definition: Empirically supported nominal trading-price basis for the bounded source-precedence decision, not API-wide unadjusted certification.
price_basis_review.contemporaneous_chart_caveat: Charts are labeled front-adjusted; only their selected latest-session OHLC at the then-current date is used as nominal-price corroboration.

limitations.upstream_discrepancy_cause: UNKNOWN; no signed supplier explanation or correction notice obtained.
limitations.historical_revision_history: UNKNOWN; selects the version retrieved on 2026-10-25, not a certification of what the exchange served in 2020.

required_controls: Preserve the complete original conflict audit, both source values, and original hashes.
Apply only to the registered exact twenty source-value tuples; changed or additional discrepancies must fail closed.
Do not treat missing secondary evidence as this source review or relax price tolerance.
Do not publish bulk raw history, source JS/HTML or broker PDFs based only on public accessibility.
Implementation verification and a separate activation commit are required; this is approval of the stated evidence-based selection policy only.
